lessons_used: Predictions were generally too optimistic, except for winning home wait_info tests where predictions were lower than measured.
Adding a new screen at the adoption stage (2 tests) or finish stage (2 tests) consistently hurt performance and was stopped early.
Home wait_info changes (10 tests) were helpful in three significant wins, while no clear effect was seen in the remaining seven tests.

Reordering sign-in steps (2 tests), adding sign-in hints (2 tests), modifying finish layouts (2 tests), changing finish copy (2 tests), and home redesigns (2 tests) consistently showed no clear effect.
Evidence for kinds of change with only one test or conflicting results remains thin.

candidates.title: Interactive Pet Activity & Mood Waiting Stage
candidates.change: Redesign the generation waiting screen into an interactive stage with an animated pet mood simulator while waiting for desktop generation.
candidates.why: The home stage has a median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s, and earlier home wait_info tests showed consistent conversion gains.

guard.reason: replacement for 'waiting.wait_status' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['preview', 'progress', 'timer']

candidates.title: Interactive Story Scroll & Mascot Hero Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the intro story screen into a story scroll layout featuring an animated companion mascot to engage users before path selection.
candidates.why: Path selection drops off at 79.4% with high mean time (514s), suggesting users need stronger initial engagement.

intro_story.text: Meet your future desktop companion and choose how you want to build your bond.

guard.reason: replacement for 'story.intro_story' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['animation', 'image', 'mascot', 'video'] with an asset:story/ asset

candidates.title: Companion Personality Alignment Flow
candidates.change: Introduce a interactive choice-card quiz sub-flow directly on the choose path screen to align users with their ideal companion path.
candidates.why: Users take an average of 514s on path selection, indicating hesitation when choosing how to start.

components.label: Which pet interaction style fits your workflow best?

guard.reason: 'choose_path.components[0].label' must be text up to 40 characters

candidates.title: Pet Data Account Safeguard Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the sign-in options into a spotlight view with explicit pet account sync badges reassuring returning users.
candidates.why: Support receives frequent complaints about pets missing or reset after signing in again (8 emails).

sign_in.headline: Sign In & Protect Your Pet Data

sign_in_options.text: Your desktop companion profiles will safely sync to this account.

guard.reason: 'sign_in.replace.sign_in_options[0]': a badge cannot do the sign_in_options job (use ['button', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'text'])

candidates.title: Desktop Launch Console & Visibility Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the home intro screen into a split console showing desktop controls, tray icon hints, and visibility toggle instructions.
candidates.why: Support received multiple reports of users unable to find, control, hide, or launch their pet after finishing setup.

home_welcome.text: Right-click system tray to hide/show pet; use desktop shortcuts to trigger commands.

guard.reason: replacement for 'home_intro.home_welcome' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['animation', 'image', 'mascot', 'text'] with real words

candidates.title: Desktop Generation Time Remaining Countdown
candidates.change: Display an active countdown timer with progress indicator and desktop readiness notification toggle on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Home stage wait times average over 38 minutes (mean 2336s), leading to user dropoff or confusion.

guard.reason: Timer is permitted on waiting screen because generation represents a real wait time.

candidates.score_note: Home wait_info changes historically yield positive results and target significant wait time friction.

candidates.title: Pet Customization Photo Quality Guidance
candidates.change: Add clear photo requirement hints on the photo upload screen explaining lighting and background recommendations.
candidates.why: Support received reports of custom pet creation failing or rendering incorrectly (3 emails), and adoption dropoff is 68.8%.

upload_photos.hint: Use well-lit photos with a single clear subject to prevent desktop pet rendering errors.

guard.reason: Adds helpful photo quality guidance on upload photos step without violating rules.

candidates.score_note: Strong funnel dropoff and support email evidence, but adoption hint tests consistently underperformed.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Name Clarity Copy
candidates.change: Update adoption certificate copy to emphasize that pet names and registration are stored to your account prior to generation.
candidates.why: Reduces adoption hesitation and clarifies account-pet association before generation starts.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Desktop Companion Registration
adoption_certificate.body: Give your desktop companion a name. Registration links directly to your profile so your pet is never lost.

guard.reason: Updates adoption certificate copy while preserving the registration/adoption process.

candidates.score_note: Target step loses users, but no support mail evidence and adoption copy changes previously degraded conversion.

candidates.title: Sign-In Connection & Recovery Notification
candidates.change: Add a fallback hint and assist notification on sign-in screen for users experiencing connection stalls.
candidates.why: 2 support emails specifically reported sign-in screen stalling or failing to load.

sign_in.hint: Stuck loading? Verify your internet connection or choose an alternate sign-in provider below.

guard.reason: Adds a troubleshooting hint to sign-in screen without removing functionality or violating fair design.

candidates.score_note: Clear support email and funnel evidence; sign-in guidance/hints show mild positive historical lift.

candidates.title: Starter Companion Perk Showcase
candidates.change: Display a promotional starter badge on the choose path screen highlighting included desktop companion features.
candidates.why: Only 79.4% convert past path selection; an upfront incentive boosts initial commitment.

components.text: Includes Free Desktop Pet Starter Pack & Customization Items

guard.reason: Onboarding copy explicitly mentions 'Free' starter pack extras, violating pricing copy rules.

lessons_next: Predictions were generally too optimistic, but underestimated gains on winning home wait_info tests.
Adding new screens at adoption (2 tests) or finish (2 tests) consistently hurt performance and required early stops.
Home wait_info changes (11 tests) were helpful in three winning tests, while eight showed no clear effect.

Reordering sign-in steps (2 tests), adding sign-in hints (2 tests), modifying finish layouts (2 tests), changing finish copy (2 tests), and home redesigns (2 tests) consistently showed no clear effect.
Evidence remains thin for categories with only one test or with conflicting results across tests.
